## Clarifications resolved
- [author] theme — Q: The theme here is taken from the named game rather than from anything you said - should it read as bright anime pirate, or something else? A: Use a bright anime pirate theme, matching the Blox Fruits style.
- [author] scale — Q: Do you want the whole archipelago in one map, or one island to start with? A: Start with one small island so the map is focused and playable.
- [author] goal — Q: What does the player actually do on this map - fight, sail between islands, grind levels? A: The player should fight enemies and grind levels on the island; sailing between islands is not needed for this first map.

## Enriched image prompt
Create one small, focused bright-anime pirate island for an RPG combat and level-grinding loop. Keep the island as one contiguous walkable map, with a safe arrival area at one edge and one or more open hostile clearings inland where enemies can be fought repeatedly. Surround the island with sea as a firm visual boundary; no sailing route or second island is needed. Use a colorful stylized tropical-pirate register and keep the complete island readable in one isometric frame.

## Genre
RPG is the dominant genre.

## Shape and preset
Use `world-open`, Single Contiguous Map, reframed as one compact island rather than an archipelago. Preset: none; the brief specifies a focused combat-grinding island but does not supply the town, dungeon, survival, or turn-based structure of an RPG preset.

## Config requirements
Use `hazard-aggro` for open hostile clearings placed inland and separated from the safe arrival edge. Use `water-body` for the sea around the island as a non-sailing boundary. Do not add shops, towns, dungeons, level gates, collectible resources, or additional islands that the author did not request.

## Layout requirements
Use `spawner-npc` for enemy emitters inside the hostile clearings, set back from the arrival area. Place one free-text SpawnZone at the safe edge of the island, oriented toward the inland combat ground. Enemy combat, level gains, and grinding progression are mechanics rather than extra layout components.

## Layout components
The build contains one small island zone only. A safe arrival edge connects by a short open route to inland enemy-fighting clearings. The sea encloses every side and forms the map boundary, with no docks or inter-island route required. Keep combat ground broad enough for movement and keep enemy origins out of the starting sightline. Compose the entire island, arrival point, hostile ground, shoreline, and surrounding water in one frame.

## Render order
Use `isometric`: the simple island silhouette, safe-to-hostile spatial gradient, and colorful pirate-fantasy treatment should lead, with the top-down surface derived afterward.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is medium, driven by a compact island where individual combat clearings remain legible. The theme is bright anime pirate fantasy. Use `CHECK` because real surrounding water is part of the map even though it acts as a boundary; no P3, P4, or P6 pass is required.
